claims.text: The general was a correspondent, not only a subject. The 'DeLonge/Podesta Meeting' thread of 24 and 25 January 2016 runs between Podesta and [a personal Gmail address], who signs 'Neil McC' and whom the Google calendar invitation names as Neil McCasland, copied to [DeLonge's personal address], [a Clinton campaign staff address], [Weiss's Lockheed Martin address] and [a personal Gmail address]. Podesta organised the meeting as a Google Hangout and moved it to 12:30 Eastern after a blizzard.
